notes.title: Happy Holidays! Update 1.2 Is Out Now!
notes.content:
To make your holidays even happier, here's our rad gift to you: a brand-new content update!

[list]
[*]Meet Codger the Elf, a weird old guy in Powder Peaks who needs Niko's help in a new island-spanning quest
[*]Conquer brain-shivering new levels to find all the missing presents
[*]Earn a brand-new costume for Niko if you've got enough holiday moxie to finish Codger's quest
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 Is Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]New Features and Improvements:[/b] 

• Added boatloads of new music, so you can now enjoy 60 minutes of Disasterpeace tunes  
• Fixed some level Challenges 
• Fixed issues that caused some of the Messages in a Bottle to not appear correctly 
• All achievements attained while offline or that were not previously credited will now be correctly registered 
• MAMBC now supports the following languages: English, French, Italian, Spanish (Latinamerican), Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese
